metadata.title: Triangulation of orbifolds with corners
metadata.abstract: We prove that every compact orbifold with corners admits a triangulation in which the image of every codimension one face is a subcomplex. Faces need not be embedded, and the local groups may permute boundary components. The proof turns the boundary hyperplanes of linear charts into mirrors by means of the squaring map, which, unlike the folding $y\mapsto|y|$, is compatible with smooth changes of charts, and then applies the triangulation theorem for orbit spaces of proper Lie groupoids.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 证明每个紧致带角 orbifold 存在适配余维一面的三角剖分。
techniques: proper Lie 群胚轨道空间三角剖分
analysis.breakthrough: 允许面非嵌入和局部群置换边界分支，仍使每个余维一面的像成为子复形。
analysis.limitations: 紧致性属于陈述范围；平方映射用于保证坐标变换相容，不能直接替换成绝对值折叠而保持相同光滑结论。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
